name: ... and that note you found
summary: In Westfall, a scorched note survives beside a dying campfire. Its brief message points toward a place called the twin land.

sections.title: A Dying Fire
sections.body: Across Westfall's abandoned fields and wind-scoured plains, travelers find camps left by vagrants, outlaws, and desperate wanderers. This small camp may have been left in haste or secrecy; its provisions lie abandoned, and embers still glow. A scorched slip of parchment rests among the scattered debris.

sections.title: The Cryptic Message
sections.body: The blistered note bears two short sentences: “Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place.” The words point away from Westfall, but give no clear direction. What place shares a name, geography, or fate with this land?

aliases: what is written on the note
faq.answer: The blistered note reads, “Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place.” It is the only clue at the abandoned campsite.
The note lies among the remains of a fire and scattered provisions in the wilderness of Westfall.
No one knows who left the camp. Whoever made the fire departed recently, leaving scattered supplies and the scorched message among the embers.

faq.q: What does 'the twin land' refer to?
faq.answer: “The twin land” points to another region connected to the land where the note was found, but the charred message gives no further explanation.

aliases: did someone try to burn the note
faq.answer: The note was blistered and charred in the embers. Someone may have tried to destroy it in haste, or left it carelessly as the flames died down.

faq.q: Is this connected to the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: Westfall is overrun by the Defias Brotherhood and destitute squatters, but the cryptic message suggests something more obscure than ordinary bandit communications.

angles.text: As a rogue, you know how to decipher cryptic clues left in hidden campsites; such work comes naturally to those who live by whispers, secrets, and concealed messages.
As an Alliance adventurer trying to restore order to Westfall, you face another mystery on the kingdom's frontier: an unidentified camp and an enigmatic cipher.
